verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is Pomelo's documented ability to issue innominate cards in batches (lotes), which are shipped to and stored at a logistics partner. That is a first-party bulk operation, but only for one item type and one action, and the docs do not describe it as a programmatic bulk API. Missing for 10: a general bulk/batch API endpoint, bulk updates or actions on users, cards or transactions, documented batch limits and error handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Emites lotes de tarjetas innominadas que enviamos y almacenamos de forma segura en el centro de almacenamiento de nuestro partner logístico.
